notes.unbounded-native-threads: Initial diagnostic omitted the worker native-thread environment; retained, not representative of production.
notes.production-native-thread-limits: Matches four worker thread limits; no-fence variant is diagnostic only because unbounded queued uploads need separate admission.
notes.first-compatible-selection: Intermediate selector fix; no substantial performance gain.
notes.preferred-selection: Final committed selector; retained preparation and cold devices within one process, not fresh-process Jobs; large 3MF uses application-derived STL.
notes.adapter-discovery: Isolated discovery retains adapter references across observations, so it is a different lifecycle from render/close/recreate.
notes.integrated-traces: Three diagnostic cycles each; these trace phases rather than qualifying performance.

unbounded-native-threads.variant: queued draw removes intermediate copy/map/unmap fences only; final readback still waits
unbounded-native-threads.scope: Native Windows diagnostic, retained preparation, cold GPU devices, all render/encode/cleanup costs; no production Job or upload qualification

production-native-thread-limits.variant: queued draw removes intermediate copy/map/unmap fences only; final readback still waits
production-native-thread-limits.scope: Native Windows diagnostic, retained preparation, cold GPU devices, all render/encode/cleanup costs; no production Job or upload qualification

first-compatible-selection.scope: Native Windows diagnostic, retained preparation, cold GPU devices, all render/encode/cleanup costs; no production Job or upload qualification

archive_script_normalization: Archived replay scripts normalize BOM/line endings and terminal blank lines only. Per-experiment probe_sha256 identifies the original executed Windows file.
